import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
from forge_factory.common import data_root, sha256_file
v2 = json.loads(Path('evidence/easa/measurements/dry-run-observe-only-v2.json').read_text())
tri = json.loads(Path('evidence/easa/measurements/dry-run-triage.json').read_text())
pk = v2['packages']; ok = len(pk) == 10 and all(p['archive_unchanged'] for p in pk.values())
arch = [wo for wo in pk if not (lambda d: (d / next(d.glob('*.zip.sha256')).name[:-7]).is_file() and sha256_file(d / next(d.glob('*.zip.sha256')).name[:-7]) == next(d.glob('*.zip.sha256')).read_text().split()[0])(data_root()/'archives'/wo)]
print(json.dumps(v2['aggregate_status_counts']), 'fp_v1', tri['v1']['false_positive_count'], 'fp_v2', len(tri['v2']['false_positives']), 'archives_changed', arch)
sys.exit(0 if ok and not arch and tri['v2']['false_positives'] == [] else 1)
